prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic portrait of an adult woman named Sora sitting quietly beside a dark wooden window frame on the right side of the image. She has long dark brown hair, loose and slightly tousled, falling over one shoulder, with her head bowed and eyes looking down in a calm, introspective mood. She wears a fitted warm ivory short-sleeve knit dress with a deep scoop neckline and a small embroidered name detail reading “Sora” on the upper chest. Her hands rest gently in her lap, lightly holding a tiny object or ring, with one knee visible in the foreground. Use soft warm side light entering from the window, hazy golden atmosphere, muted beige plaster wall background, natural skin tones, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, and a painterly editorial photography feel. Composition should be intimate and quiet, with the subject placed slightly right of center, warm highlights on her hair and shoulder, soft shadows across the wall, and no extra objects, text overlays, logos, or watermark.
